answer: Try retro badgeholder review. First, each epoch's rewards sit in escrow for 30 days instead of paying out at once. Second, a panel of 40 badgeholders, each with a year of clean history, samples 50 answers from every cluster of accounts funded by one wallet. Third, any cluster whose answers share phrasing, timing, or a single anchor wallet forfeits the whole escrow. A farm of 200 bots earning 2 POA four times a day puts 48,000 POA at risk each month on one sloppy tell. It works like a beekeeper who tastes the nectar before selling it; a painted timber hive earns nothing.
